agents.name: debug
agents.description: Use when debugging a bug, investigating a failing test, reproducing a runtime error, or tracing unexpected application behavior to a root cause.
agents.argumentHint: Describe the bug, failing command or test, expected behavior, and any error output or reproduction steps.

agents.name: Expert React Frontend Engineer
agents.description: Use when working on JoyJoin browser-first frontend tasks in apps/user-client, React 18 plus Vite UI implementation, Wouter routes, TanStack Query pages, reviewing the web source-of-truth during an apps/mini-program update, or deciding whether a change stays web-only versus needs Taro, parity, or sibling-platform review.
agents.argumentHint: Describe the page, route, component, or interaction in apps/user-client, plus any platform-coordination concerns.

agents.name: SE: Product Manager
agents.description: Use when creating GitHub issues, aligning business value with user needs, prioritizing roadmap tradeoffs, or defining success metrics for product work.
agents.argumentHint: Describe the feature, user, current workflow, pain point, and the decision or artifact you need.

agents.name: Mini-Program Parity Auditor
agents.description: Use when comparing apps/user-client and apps/mini-program for missing parity, route coverage gaps, auth or payment drift, or when you need a migration backlog before cloning more screens into Taro.
agents.argumentHint: Describe the route, feature area, or file set to compare between apps/user-client and apps/mini-program, and whether you want a quick gap scan or a detailed backlog.

agents.name: Taro Mini-Program Frontend Engineer
agents.description: Use when implementing or refining frontend UI directly in apps/mini-program, building Taro 4 plus React 18 pages or components for a WeChat Mini Program, adapting layouts and interactions to WXSS and WeChat runtime constraints, or deciding whether an apps/mini-program change is MINI_PROGRAM_ONLY versus needing web or sibling-platform review.
agents.argumentHint: Describe the apps/mini-program page, component, route, or interaction to build or update, plus any web-parity or platform-coordination concerns.

agents.name: principal SWE
agents.description: Use when you need principal-level software engineering guidance, architecture tradeoff analysis, implementation review, or pragmatic plans for complex technical changes.
agents.argumentHint: Describe the decision, code area, architecture change, or implementation risk that needs senior guidance.

agents.name: prompt engineer
agents.description: Use when analyzing or rewriting prompts, improving system prompts, adding better examples, or tightening prompt structure for more reliable model behavior.
agents.argumentHint: Paste the prompt or instruction set you want improved, plus any goals, constraints, or desired output format.

agents.name: Taro Migration Specialist
agents.description: Use when cloning apps/user-client into apps/mini-program with Taro, porting browser-first React or Vue code to a WeChat Mini Program, identifying unsupported DOM APIs and CSS, preserving near-100% parity without modifying source user-client files, or generating and validating apps/mini-program/src/app.config.ts.
agents.argumentHint: Describe the web page, feature, or files to migrate, plus any constraints on navigation, networking, or styling.
